title: Shedding Light on Physical Fitness During Childhood: Insights From Japan's Fitness Survey.
figures: Annual trends in cardiorespiratory fitness among 5th (ages 10–11) and 8th (ages 13–14) graders in Japan from 2008 to 2023. The figure is based on the results of the JP Fit Survey for Youth [in Japanese]:  https://www.mext.go.jp/sports/content/20240115‐spt_sseisaku02‐000032954_11.pdf . No nationwide survey was conducted in 2011 due to the Great East Japan Earthquake and in 2020 due to the COVID‐19
